most_similar_reason: Candidate 5 shares the same distinctive flood narrative: gods decree the destruction of noisy humanity, a clever god secretly circumvents his oath by speaking through a reed wall to a favored wise man, who builds a sealed waterproof ship and loads it with family and animals before a multi-day deluge.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 8 is not a narrative at all but a description of cave-painting spirits and repainting rituals, with no hero, journey, warned survivor, boat, or quest for immortality.
